cases.visibleGeometry: Broad rounded slope between irregular drainage lines, with scattered small knolls and a prominent angular exposed rock in the southeast. A diagonal narrow trace crosses the northwest.
cases.alternatives: Rock outcrops, erosion channels, vegetation effects and a footpath or vehicle track account for the visible forms.
cases.supportLimits: Patch has scattered interpolated cells, especially at rough edges. No coherent enclosure or platform is clear across terrain views.

cases.visibleGeometry: Several branching incised lines converge near the lower centre. A sloping rocky shoulder on the east bears small irregular knolls; western ground is smoother. Aerial vegetation follows the drainage.
cases.alternatives: Seasonal drainage and erosion, exposed bedrock, stock trails, and vegetation or ground-classification gaps explain these traces.
cases.supportLimits: The channel and rocky shoulder contain many interpolated cells. Their jagged edges should not be read as walls without original-return checks.

cases.visibleGeometry: Regular closely spaced curved ridges cover the western field; parallel rows cover the eastern field. A nearly north-south boundary divides them, and an east-west track crosses the south.
cases.alternatives: Ploughing or plantation furrows, field terraces and modern access or drainage boundaries match the aerial pattern and wider field network.
cases.supportLimits: The north-south division has interpolated cells. Fine ridges are measured broadly, but their regular agricultural context limits interpretation.

cases.visibleGeometry: Mostly smooth open ground crossed by a narrow north-south track. Several small, irregular raised spots lie beside it, notably a cluster near the centre-right and isolated bumps toward the northwest and south.
cases.alternatives: Exposed boulders or bedrock, small shrubs, and track-related disturbance fit the aerial patches and surrounding rocky terrain.
cases.supportLimits: Ground is predominantly measured, but the bumps lack a coherent boundary or level surface. Imagery and model dates differ.
